text.text: The Cisco MDS 9718 Director is industry's highest port density director with 768 line rate Fiber Channel ports. It is 32G Fiber Channel ready, so in the future you can get 768 line rate 32G Fiber Channel ports. The MDS 9718 will enable consolidation through collapsed core architectures, and provide room for future growth.

text.text: The MDS 9718 supports 2 Supervisor Modules and allows for redundant operation as well as hitless upgrades to software with ISSU (In Service Software Upgrade). Each Supervisor Module also has LEDs that indicate System and Supervisor status, power management, logging to flash and other important indicators for a visual overview of the system.

text.text: Three fan trays are installed on the back of the MDS 9718. The fans on each fan tray are monitored and any failures are reported through LEDs as well as through the NXOS. The fan trays can be removed and replaced without turning the switch off at normal Data Center temperatures - for either fan replacement or adding/changing the fabric modules which are behind the fan trays. Fan trays also have LEDs for fabric modules which are behind them.

text.text: The fabric modules on the MDS 9718 support a crossbar architecture which guarantees low variance on the latency through the switch. Each fabric supports 256 Gbps of backplane bandwidth per slot and each fabric is hot swappable. The MDS 9718 supports a total of 6 Fabric modules.
